//: THE PUBLIC LINE-UP - the source GitHub Actions publishes from (GOAL 7; tools/schedule-tool.mjs), and what `npm run publish:public -- --at <instant>` publishes with the full SmartTV publisher on the household PC. Written channels only: a channel with time rules is published as a weekly file in source/weeks (see README.md). Everything here is public by design: only programmes anybody may know about, no household files, no provider addresses - the publisher refuses a public file that carries a household file. Where a programme plays from is NOT here: the app has its own list of approved sources (android-app/src/standalone/previewSources.ts), so adding a programme can never add an address. A channel with time rules covers one week per file and must be republished each week, before Monday 00:00 - see docs/goals/GOAL-6.md.
